title: UnitDespawned
description: A unit was removed without being destroyed (CONTRACTS §6). WRECKED is the first producer: a Disabled unit removed after combat.disabled_timeout_s, its cargo lost (COMBAT CB-7, Q-CBT-14). RETIRED: a Threat Director unit with no job for director.idle_retire_s, removed with no refund; it is not a loss (NX-156, Q-SIM-84). Other reasons join with their producers (rule 6a). Public view: a hidden ENEMY unit is dropped.
